policy.summary: Stanford Health Care states that those with a family income at or below 400 percent of the federal poverty level are generally eligible for 100 percent assistance, including uninsured patients and insured patients with high medical costs. High medical costs are defined as annual out-of-pocket costs exceeding 10 percent of the patient's family income.

sources.snippet:
[Help Paying Your Bill > Eligibility Criteria]

Those with a family income at or below 400 percent of the federal poverty level (FPL) guidelines are generally eligible for 100 percent assistance.

- Uninsured Patients who have Family Income not in excess of 400% of the most recent Federal Poverty Guidelines.
- Insured Patients with (i) a Family Income that is at or below 400% of the most recent Federal Poverty Guidelines; and (ii) high medical costs. For these purposes, “high medical costs” mean
